changelog:
kold-frontend-design v0.1.0

- Initial release with clear principles for frontend UI work using pure HTML/CSS/JS.
- Enforces design token system for all colors, spacing, radius, and typography, including OKLch color tokens and theme-based overrides for dark mode.
- Establishes a mobile-first, accessible, and progressively enhanced component pattern.
- Provides token reference scales, recommended HTML/CSS patterns, and anti-patterns to ensure consistent, accessible, and aesthetically sound design.
- Includes pre-commit checklist to guide high-quality, responsive, and accessible visual work.
